summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange regarding movements in its authorized and issued share capital for July 2026. The filing reports a decrease of 6,469,787 Class A ordinary shares, from 563,800,693 to 557,330,906, with no changes to Class B shares or authorized capital. No options, warrants, or other securities movements are noted. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of capital changes, not a special situation event.
